name: heat_limit
quote: Above 132°C: - High coolant temperature indicator and warning indicator come on. The high coolant temperature indicator is displayed in the warning information. (P.73) (P.76) - "132°C" flashes.

name: Crankcase Breather Service
value: more frequently when riding in rain, at full throttle, or af
quote: Crankcase Breather Service more frequently when riding in rain, at full throttle, or after the vehicle is washed or overturned. Service if the deposit level can be seen in the transparent section of the drain tube.

name: salt_wash
value: after riding on coastal, treated, muddy or dusty roads
quote: Always wash your vehicle thoroughly after riding on coastal, treated, muddy or dusty roads.

name: salt_wash
quote: Aluminium will corrode from contact with dirt, mud, or road salt. Clean aluminium parts regularly
